content.text:
The tests were failing because `offset` in `src/offset.js` treated pages as 0-indexed, while `pageOf` and the tests number pages from 1. Page 1 therefore started at item 5 instead of item 0.

I changed `page * perPage` to `(page - 1) * perPage`. All 4 tests now pass.
